resources.string: Round D: habits 2.0, Namoz, the new icon

string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: 🧭 Compass: write your goals; only you can read them|compass
Today’s goal line blocks screenshots while it shows|compass
Calendar: switch List · Day · 3 days · Week · Month|upcoming
Swipe the week strip left for next week, “Today” to come back|upcoming
Hold a block in Day or Week and drag it to a new time|upcoming
Notifications: pick your tone (chill · normal · no mercy) and the morning plan|notifications
Open a task with a time: “Also 10 min before”|today
Clear your last task from anywhere: the big confetti + chord|today
Close the day: your Today is empty after it, tomorrow\'s stars wait folded|shutdown
The status bar and the sheets show the mint page, no white band|today
Habits: the week on top is a chain; tap a day to look back, the Today pill brings you home|habits
Morning · Afternoon · Evening pills: your habits for that part of the day|habits
Tap the Stretch card: its 10-minute timer runs and ticks itself|habits
The dots on a card: freeze a sick day (2 a month) or take a tick back|habits
Long-press a card: its page with the chain calendar, stats, emoji and its after habit|habits
History (calendar icon): Calendar · All habits · Achievements|habits
Namoz: Start tracking; the five prayers count from 1 November|habits
The new PAGEL icon on your home screen|more
Inbox: every choice says where it went, with Open|more
Inbox Action: When? Today, Tomorrow or Someday|more
Inbox: Sorted today lists the day by where each went; Undo while it waits|more
More, Notes: each project notes from the Inbox, offline too|more
Close the day: the cards no longer jump between stars|shutdown
